verses.sloka: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः।अर्थ्यं विज्ञापयंश्चापि हनुमन्तमिदं वचः ।। ६.७५.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'bravīnmahātejāḥ sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ।arthyaṁ vijñāpayaṁścāpi hanumantamidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.75.1 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the king of Vanaras called Hanuman to make him know the task ahead and said these words.

verses.sloka: यतो हतः कुम्भकर्णः कुमाराश्च निषूदिताः।नेदानीमुपनिर्हारं रावणो दातुमर्हति ।। ६.७५.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yato hataḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ kumārāśca niṣūditāḥ।nedānīmupanirhāraṁ rāvaṇo dātumarhati ।। 6.75.2 ।।

translations.english: " As Kumbhakarna is killed and his sons are destroyed, Ravana may not putup defence again. I think."
translations.hindi: इतने में महोदर भी अत्यन्त कुपित हो शीघ्रतापूचेक एक दूसरे पर्बत के समान ऊँचे हाथी पर सवार हुआ । उस समय बह्‌ जैसा ही जान पड़ा, जैसा ( अरत होने वाला ) सूय, मन्दराचल पर स्थित होने पर जान पड़ता हे

verses.sloka: ये ये महाबलाः सन्ति लघवश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।लङ्कामभ्युत्पतन्त्वाशु गृह्योल्काः प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.७५.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ye ye mahābalāḥ santi laghavaśca plavaṅgamāḥ।laṅkāmabhyutpatantvāśu gṛhyolkāḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.75.3 ।।

translations.english: "Of the bulls among vanaras, endowed with prowess, whoever is quick, able and foremost, let them go to Lanka, the abode of Ravana."

verses.sloka: ततो ऽस्तं गत आदित्ये रौद्रे तस्मिन्निशामुखे।लङ्कामभिमुखाः सोल्का जग्मुस्ते प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.७५.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'staṁ gata āditye raudre tasminniśāmukhe।laṅkāmabhimukhāḥ solkā jagmuste plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.75.4 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the bulls among Vanaras turned their faces towards Lanka and went holding torches in hand, after the Sun set as the frightening night started.

verses.sloka: उल्काहस्तैर्हरिगणैः सर्वतः समभिद्रुताः।आरक्षस्था विरूपाक्षाः सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.७५.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ulkāhastairharigaṇaiḥ sarvataḥ samabhidrutāḥ।ārakṣasthā virūpākṣāḥ sahasā vipradudruvuḥ ।। 6.75.5 ।।

translations.english: Vanara troops went all over with torches and chased by them, the Rakshasas at the gates ran instantly.

verses.sloka: गोपुराट्टप्रतोलीषु चर्यासु विविधासु च।प्रासादेषु च संहृष्टाः ससृजुस्ते हुताशनम्।तेषां गृहसस्राणि ददाह हुतभुक् तदा ।। ६.७५.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: gopurāṭṭapratolīṣu caryāsu vividhāsu ca।prāsādeṣu ca saṁhṛṣṭāḥ sasṛjuste hutāśanam।teṣāṁ gṛhasasrāṇi dadāha hutabhuk tadā ।। 6.75.6 ।।

translations.english: Rejoiced Vanaras set fire to the towering gates, attics, different streets as well as mansions to send away Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: प्रासादाः पर्वताकाराः पतन्ति धरणीतले।अगरुर्दह्यते तत्र वर च हरिचन्दनम् ।। ६.७५.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāsādāḥ parvatākārāḥ patanti dharaṇītale।agarurdahyate tatra vara ca haricandanam ।। 6.75.7 ।।

translations.english: Then thousands of their houses were burnt by fire (consumer of offerings), and mountain like mansions collapsed to the ground.

verses.sloka: मौक्तिका मणयः स्निग्धा वज्रं चापि प्रवालकम्।क्षौमं च दह्यते तत्र कौशेयं चापि शोभनम् ।। ६.७५.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mauktikā maṇayaḥ snigdhā vajraṁ cāpi pravālakam।kṣaumaṁ ca dahyate tatra kauśeyaṁ cāpi śobhanam ।। 6.75.8 ।।

translations.english: There, in Lanka, incense and the best of sandalwood was burnt. Nay even glossy pearls, gems and diamonds were also burnt.

verses.sloka: आविकं विविधं चौर्णं काञ्चनं भाण्डमायुधम्।नानाविकृतसंस्थानं वाजिभाण्डपरिच्छदौ ।। ६.७५.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: āvikaṁ vividhaṁ caurṇaṁ kāñcanaṁ bhāṇḍamāyudham।nānāvikṛtasaṁsthānaṁ vājibhāṇḍaparicchadau ।। 6.75.9 ।।

translations.english: Their white linen and beautiful silks were burnt. Nay, even several blankets of wool, chests and weapons were also burnt.

verses.sloka: गजग्रैवेयकक्ष्याश्च रथभाण्डाश्च संस्कृताः।तनुत्राणि च योधानां हस्त्यश्वानां च वर्म च ।। ६.७५.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: gajagraiveyakakṣyāśca rathabhāṇḍāśca saṁskṛtāḥ।tanutrāṇi ca yodhānāṁ hastyaśvānāṁ ca varma ca ।। 6.75.10 ।।

translations.english: Different kinds of peculiar kinds of ornaments used to decorate horses, ornaments worn round the neck and girths of elephants, and polished chariot decorations.

verses.sloka: खड्गा धनूंषि ज्याबाणास्तोमराङ्कुशशक्तयः।रोमजं वालजं चर्म व्याघ्रजं चाण्डजं बहु ।। ६.७५.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: khaḍgā dhanūṁṣi jyābāṇāstomarāṅkuśaśaktayaḥ।romajaṁ vālajaṁ carma vyāghrajaṁ cāṇḍajaṁ bahu ।। 6.75.11 ।।

translations.english: Leather armour of the warriors, shields of horses, excellent bow strings, swords, arrows, goads, lances, and javelins.

verses.sloka: मुक्तामणिविचित्रांश्च प्रासादांश्च समन्ततः।विविधानस्त्रसंयोगानग्निर्दहति तत्र वै ।। ६.७५.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: muktāmaṇivicitrāṁśca prāsādāṁśca samantataḥ।vividhānastrasaṁyogānagnirdahati tatra vai ।। 6.75.12 ।।

translations.english: With fire all over, rugs made of hair of animals, whisks made of fur of animals, tiger skins, musk, wonderful pearls, and gems in laid dwellings of many kinds, and clusters of war weapons were burnt.

verses.sloka: नानाविधान् गृहच्छन्दान् ददाह हुतभूक् तदा।आवासान् राक्षसानां च सर्वेषां गृहगर्धिनाम् ।। ६.७५.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānāvidhān gṛhacchandān dadāha hutabhūk tadā।āvāsān rākṣasānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ gṛhagardhinām ।। 6.75.13 ।।

translations.english: With fire all over, rugs made of hair of animals, whisks made of fur of animals, tiger skins, musk, wonderful pearls, and gems in laid dwellings of many kinds, and clusters of war weapons were burnt.

verses.sloka: हेमचित्रतनुत्राणां स्रग्दामाम्बरधारिणाम्।शीधुपानचलाक्षाणां मदविह्वलगामिनाम् ।। ६.७५.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: hemacitratanutrāṇāṁ sragdāmāmbaradhāriṇām।śīdhupānacalākṣāṇāṁ madavihvalagāminām ।। 6.75.14 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

verses.sloka: कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां शत्रुसञ्जातमन्युनाम्।गदाशूलासिहस्तानां खादतां पिबतामपि ।। ६.७५.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāntālambitavastrāṇāṁ śatrusañjātamanyunām।gadāśūlāsihastānāṁ khādatāṁ pibatāmapi ।। 6.75.15 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

verses.sloka: शयनेषु महार्हेषु प्रसुप्तानां प्रियैः सह।त्रस्तानां गच्छतां तूर्णं पुत्रानादाय सर्वतः ।। ६.७५.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śayaneṣu mahārheṣu prasuptānāṁ priyaiḥ saha।trastānāṁ gacchatāṁ tūrṇaṁ putrānādāya sarvataḥ ।। 6.75.16 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

verses.sloka: तेषां शतसहस्राणि तदा लङ्कानिवासिनाम्।अदहत् पावकस्तत्र जज्वाल च पुनःपुनः ।। ६.७५.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ śatasahasrāṇi tadā laṅkānivāsinām।adahat pāvakastatra jajvāla ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.75.17 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

verses.sloka: सारवन्ति महार्हाणि गम्भीरगुणवन्ति च।हेमचन्द्रार्धचन्द्राणि चन्द्रशालोन्नतानि च ।। ६.७५.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sāravanti mahārhāṇi gambhīraguṇavanti ca।hemacandrārdhacandrāṇi candraśālonnatāni ca ।। 6.75.18 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.

verses.sloka: रत्नचित्रगवाक्षाणि साधिष्ठानानि सर्वशः।मणिविद्रुमचित्राणि स्पृशन्तीव दिवाकरम् ।। ६.७५.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ratnacitragavākṣāṇi sādhiṣṭhānāni sarvaśaḥ।maṇividrumacitrāṇi spṛśantīva divākaram ।। 6.75.19 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.

verses.sloka: क्रौञ्चबर्हिणवीणानां भूषणानां च निस्वनैः।नादितान्यचला भानि वेश्मान्यग्निर्ददाह सः ।। ६.७५.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: krauñcabarhiṇavīṇānāṁ bhūṣaṇānāṁ ca nisvanaiḥ।nāditānyacalā bhāni veśmānyagnirdadāha saḥ ।। 6.75.20 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.

verses.sloka: ज्वलनेन परीतानि तोरणानि चकाशिरे।विद्युद्भिरिव नद्धानि मेघजालानि धर्मगे ।। ६.७५.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: jvalanena parītāni toraṇāni cakāśire।vidyudbhiriva naddhāni meghajālāni dharmage ।। 6.75.21 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.

verses.sloka: ज्वलनेन परीतानि निपेतुर्भवनान्यथ।वज्रिवज्रहतानीव शिखराणि महागिरेः ।। ६.७५.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: jvalanena parītāni nipeturbhavanānyatha।vajrivajrahatānīva śikharāṇi mahāgireḥ ।। 6.75.22 ।।

translations.english: The archways covered with a touch of fire shone like lightning in summer, girt round like clusters of clouds.
translations.hindi: महोदर उस शैल के प्रहार से अपने उस मह! गज सहित चकनाचूर हो गया और निर्जीव हो भूमि पर वैसे ही गिर पड़ा ; जैसे बज के प्रहार से टूट कर पर्वत भूमि पर गिरता हे

verses.sloka: विमानेषु प्रसुप्ताश्च दह्यमाना वराङ्गनाः।त्यक्ताभरणसर्वाङ्गा हा हेत्युच्चैर्विचुक्रुशुः ।। ६.७५.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vimāneṣu prasuptāśca dahyamānā varāṅganāḥ।tyaktābharaṇasarvāṅgā hā hetyuccairvicukruśuḥ ।। 6.75.23 ।।

translations.english: The mansions burnt by fire fell down like a huge mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.sloka: तानि निर्दह्यमानानि दूरतः प्रचकाशिरे।हिमवच्छिखराणीव दीप्तौषधिवनानि च ।। ६.७५.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāni nirdahyamānāni dūrataḥ pracakāśire।himavacchikharāṇīva dīptauṣadhivanāni ca ।। 6.75.24 ।।

translations.english: The lovely women sleeping in burnt mansion tops screamed loudly in desperation saying 'Alas! Oh Oh!' and removing their ornaments.

verses.sloka: हर्म्याग्रैर्दह्यमानैश्च ज्वालाप्रज्वलितैरपि।रात्रौ सा दृश्यते लङ्का पुष्पितैरिव किंशुकैः ।। ६.७५.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: harmyāgrairdahyamānaiśca jvālāprajvalitairapi।rātrau sā dṛśyate laṅkā puṣpitairiva kiṁśukaiḥ ।। 6.75.25 ।।

translations.english: Like peaks of mountains struck by thunderbolt the mansions also fell, caught in fire.

verses.sloka: हस्त्यध्यक्षैर्गजैर्मुक्तैर्मुक्तैश्च तुरगैरपि।बभूव लङ्का लोकान्ते भ्रान्तग्राह इवार्णवः ।। ६.७५.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: hastyadhyakṣairgajairmuktairmuktaiśca turagairapi।babhūva laṅkā lokānte bhrāntagrāha ivārṇavaḥ ।। 6.75.26 ।।

translations.english: As the mansions were burning, they shone like the peaks of Himalayas glowing at a distance.
translations.hindi: उसले भी नील की छाती पर बाँणों की वर्षा की। उस समय ऐसा जान पड़ा; मानों इन्द्रधनुप ओर बिजलीयुक्त मेघ, पर्वेत पर जल की वषी करता हो

verses.sloka: अश्वं मुक्तं गजो दृष्ट्वा क्वचिद्भीतो ऽपसर्पति।भीतो भीतं गजं दृष्ट्वा क्वचिदश्वो निवर्तते ।। ६.७५.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: aśvaṁ muktaṁ gajo dṛṣṭvā kvacidbhīto 'pasarpati।bhīto bhītaṁ gajaṁ dṛṣṭvā kvacidaśvo nivartate ।। 6.75.27 ।।

translations.english: While the tops of dwellings were burning, flames were blazing, and Lanka seemed adorned with Kimsuka blossoms.

verses.sloka: लङ्कायां दह्यमानायां शुशुभे स महार्णवः।छायासंसक्तसलिलो लोहितोद इवार्णवः ।। ६.७५.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkāyāṁ dahyamānāyāṁ śuśubhe sa mahārṇavaḥ।chāyāsaṁsaktasalilo lohitoda ivārṇavaḥ ।। 6.75.28 ।।

translations.english: In Lanka with the elephants set free, horses set free by the guards, it was like an agitated ocean at the end of the world cycle.

verses.sloka: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन हरिभिर्दीपिता पुरी।लोकस्यास्य क्षये घोरे प्रदीप्तेव वसुन्धरा ।। ६.७५.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sā babhūva muhūrtena haribhirdīpitā purī।lokasyāsya kṣaye ghore pradīpteva vasundharā ।। 6.75.29 ।।

translations.english: Some horses that were released, went in different directions afraid of elephants. Some elephants seeing horses ran away in fear.

verses.sloka: नारीजनस्य धूमेन व्याप्तस्योच्चैर्विनेदुषः।स्वनो ज्वलनतप्तस्य शुश्रुवे दशयोजनम् ।। ६.७५.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: nārījanasya dhūmena vyāptasyoccairvineduṣaḥ।svano jvalanataptasya śuśruve daśayojanam ।। 6.75.30 ।।

translations.english: While Lanka was burning its image reflected in the ocean made the ocean look like an ocean of red waters.
translations.hindi: कपिवाहिनी के सेनापति नील का सारा शरीर उस बाखदृष्टि से क्षतविक्षत हो गया। उसके शरीर के सारे अङ्ग शिथिल पड़े: गए । महाबली महोदर ने वील को स्तब्ध अथात्‌ मुच्छित कंर दिआ

verses.sloka: प्रदग्धकायानपरान् राक्षसान्निर्गतान् बहिः।सहसा ऽभ्युत्पतन्ति स्म हरयो ऽथ युयुत्सवः ।। ६.७५.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: pradagdhakāyānaparān rākṣasānnirgatān bahiḥ।sahasā 'bhyutpatanti sma harayo 'tha yuyutsavaḥ ।। 6.75.31 ।।

translations.english: Set fire by the monkeys, in a short while, the city was like a land flaming out of dreadful destruction in the world.
translations.hindi: कुछ देर पीछे जब नील सचेत हुए, तब इन्होंने पेड़ों सहित एक शैल को उखाड़ लिया और बड़े वेग से डछल कर, उस शेल से सहोदर के सिर में प्रहार किआ

verses.sloka: उद्घुष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः।दिशो दश समुद्रं च पृथिवीं चान्वनादयत् ।। ६.७५.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: udghuṣṭaṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ।diśo daśa samudraṁ ca pṛthivīṁ cānvanādayat ।। 6.75.32 ।।

translations.english: By the smoke that spread, scorched by the fire, the clamour of the women folk at the top of their voice was heard at a hundred yojanas.

verses.sloka: विशल्यौ तु महात्मानौ तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।असम्भ्रान्तौ जगृहतुस्तदोभे धनुषी वरे ।। ६.७५.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: viśalyau tu mahātmānau tāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau।asambhrāntau jagṛhatustadobhe dhanuṣī vare ।। 6.75.33 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter the monkeys who were eager to fight assailed the Rakshasas who came out suddenly unable to bear the burning of the bodies.
translations.hindi: अपने चचा महोदर को मरा हुआ देख, त्रिशिरा अत्यन्त कुपित हुआ ओर हनुमान जी को पेने पेने बाणों से घायल करने लगा

verses.sloka: ततो विष्फारयानस्य रामस्य धनुरुत्तमम्।बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो राक्षसानां भयावहः ।। ६.७५.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato viṣphārayānasya rāmasya dhanuruttamam।babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo rākṣasānāṁ bhayāvahaḥ ।। 6.75.34 ।।

translations.english: The clamour of the monkeys and the sighing of the Rakshasas resounded in all the ten directions including the ocean as well as the earth.
translations.hindi: उस युद्ध में शैलश्वङ्ग को निष्फल हुआ देख, हनुमान जी रावणतनय त्रिशिरा को लक्ष्य बना, उसके ऊपर वृक्षो की वर्षी करने लगे

verses.sloka: अशोभत तदा रामो धनुर्विष्फारयन् महत्।भगवानिव सङ्क्रुद्धो भवो वेदमयं धनुः ।। ६.७५.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: aśobhata tadā rāmo dhanurviṣphārayan mahat।bhagavāniva saṅkruddho bhavo vedamayaṁ dhanuḥ ।। 6.75.35 ।।

translations.english: The two great souls, Rama, and Lakshmana, both relieved of pain seized hold of excellent and wellknown bows.

verses.sloka: उद्घुष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्वनम्।ज्याशब्दस्तावुभौ शब्दावति रामस्य शुश्रुवे ।। ६.७५.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: udghuṣṭaṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanam।jyāśabdastāvubhau śabdāvati rāmasya śuśruve ।। 6.75.36 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama drew the best of bow, that created fear among the Rakshasas by its tumultuous sound.
translations.hindi: किन्तु प्रतापी त्रिशिरा उन सब वृत्षों को अपने ऊपर आते देख बीच ही में पैने तीर मार और उनके डुकड़े टकड़े कर उन सब को भूमि पर गिरा देता था और गजेता था

verses.sloka: वानरोद्घुष्टघोषश्च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः।ज्याशब्दश्चापि रामस्य त्रयं व्याप दिशो दश ।। ६.७५.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarodghuṣṭaghoṣaśca rākṣasānāṁ ca nisvanaḥ।jyāśabdaścāpi rāmasya trayaṁ vyāpa diśo daśa ।। 6.75.37 ।।

translations.english: Then, great Rama stretching his bow in great fury shone as though the divine Lord Siva was stretching his bow with imprints of Vedas.

verses.sloka: तस्य कार्मुकमुक्तैश्च शरैस्तत्पुरगोपुरम्।कैलासशृङ्गप्रतिमं विकीर्णमपतद्भुवि ।। ६.७५.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya kārmukamuktaiśca śaraistatpuragopuram।kailāsaśṛṅgapratimaṁ vikīrṇamapatadbhuvi ।। 6.75.38 ।।

translations.english: That sound of the twang of Rama's bow could be heard very high over and above the sounds of the Vanaras and Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: ततो रामशरान् दृष्ट्वा विमानेषु गृहेषु च।सन्नाहो राक्षसेन्द्राणां तुमुलः समपद्यत ।। ६.७५.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāmaśarān dṛṣṭvā vimāneṣu gṛheṣu ca।sannāho rākṣasendrāṇāṁ tumulaḥ samapadyata ।। 6.75.39 ।।

translations.english: The sound of Rama's bow twang, the clamour of the Vanaras as well as the wailing of Rakshasas, all the three could be heard in all ten directions.

verses.sloka: तेषां सन्नह्यमानानां सिंहनादं च कुर्वताम्।शर्वरी राक्षसेन्द्राणां रौद्रीव समपद्यत ।। ६.७५.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ sannahyamānānāṁ siṁhanādaṁ ca kurvatām।śarvarī rākṣasendrāṇāṁ raudrīva samapadyata ।। 6.75.40 ।।

translations.english: The entrance gate of Lanka, which was like Kailasa, crumbled and fell by the shaft released from the bow of Rama.
translations.hindi: उस भयङ्कर प्रकाश वाली साँग को हनुमान द्वारा टूटा हुआ देख, वानरगण अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हो बादलों की तरह गजने लगे

verses.sloka: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रास्तु सुग्रीवेण महात्मना।आसन्नद्वारमासाद्य युध्यध्वं प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ६.७५.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādiṣṭā vānarendrāstu sugrīveṇa mahātmanā।āsannadvāramāsādya yudhyadhvaṁ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 6.75.41 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Rama's arrows on the highrise mansions and houses, the Rakshasa leaders started preparing for comb at out of fear.

verses.sloka: यश्च वो वितथं कुर्यात्तत्र तत्र ह्युपस्थितः।स हन्तव्यो हि सम्प्लुत्य राजशासनदूषकः ।। ६.७५.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaśca vo vitathaṁ kuryāttatra tatra hyupasthitaḥ।sa hantavyo hi samplutya rājaśāsanadūṣakaḥ ।। 6.75.42 ।।

translations.english: As the Rakshasa leaders were preparing (for attack) and emitting leonine roar, night came upon like the night of Rudra (night of final dissolution).
translations.hindi: घोरतंकाशां-भयंकरप्रकाशां। ( गो०) २ व्युढे-विशाले। ( गो० ) _ >> 60:23 ७३८ युद्धकाण्डे उस खड्ग के प्रहार से घायल हो, पवननन्दन हनुमान जी ने उसकी छाती में एक थपेड़ सारी

verses.sloka: तेषु वानरमुख्येषु दीप्तोल्कोज्ज्वलपाणिषु।स्थितेषु द्वारमासाद्य रावणं मन्युराविशत् ।। ६.७५.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣu vānaramukhyeṣu dīptolkojjvalapāṇiṣu।sthiteṣu dvāramāsādya rāvaṇaṁ manyurāviśat ।। 6.75.43 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva the great king of Vanaras commanded all the bulls among Vanaras, to encounter after reaching the gate of Lanka. "He who is staying wherever they are does not obey the king's command will be killed for being guilty of flouting the command", ordered Sugriva to the Vanaras.
translations.hindi: उस थप्पड़ की चोट से सहातेजस्वी त्रिशिरा के गाथ से आयुध छूट पड़ा और बह स्त्र्यं भी भूछित हो, भूमि पर गिर पड़ा

verses.sloka: तस्य जृम्भितविक्षेपाद्व्यामिश्रा वै दिशो दश।रूपवानिव रुद्रस्य मन्युर्गात्रेष्वदृश्यत ।। ६.७५.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya jṛmbhitavikṣepādvyāmiśrā vai diśo daśa।rūpavāniva rudrasya manyurgātreṣvadṛśyata ।। 6.75.44 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva the great king of Vanaras commanded all the bulls among Vanaras, to encounter after reaching the gate of Lanka. "He who is staying wherever they are does not obey the king's command will be killed for being guilty of flouting the command", ordered Sugriva to the Vanaras.
translations.hindi: जब बह सूर्छित हो प्रथिडी पर गिर पड़ा, तब हनुमान जी ने उसके हाथ से तलवार छीन ली। वइनम्तर पव के समान विशाल शरीरधारी हचुमाय्‌ जी, समस्त राक्षसा को त्रस्त करते हुए सिंहनाद करने लगे

verses.sloka: स निकुम्भं च कुम्भं च कुम्भकर्णात्मजावुभौ।प्रेषयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सह ।। ६.७५.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa nikumbhaṁ ca kumbhaṁ ca kumbhakarṇātmajāvubhau।preṣayāmāsa saṅkruddho rākṣasairbahubhiḥ saha ।। 6.75.45 ।।

translations.english: Holding burning torches in hand the Vanara chiefs reached and standing at the gate, saw that Ravana was overtaken by anger.

verses.sloka: यूपाक्षः शोणिताक्षश्च प्रजङ्घः कम्पनस्तथा।निर्ययुः कौम्भकर्णिभ्यां सह रावणशासनात् ।। ६.७५.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yūpākṣaḥ śoṇitākṣaśca prajaṅghaḥ kampanastathā।niryayuḥ kaumbhakarṇibhyāṁ saha rāvaṇaśāsanāt ।। 6.75.46 ।।

translations.english: The ten directions were disturbed violently by his yawning and his wrath was perceptible like Rudra' s form in his limbs by his wrath.
translations.hindi: उस सुष्टिप्रहार से हनुमान जी का बड़ा क्रोध उपजा और क्रुद्ध हो उन्होंने उसका किरीट पकड लिया

verses.sloka: शशास चैव तान् सर्वान् राक्षसान् सुमहाबलान्।नादयन् गच्छतात्रैव जयध्वं शीघ्रमेव च ।। ६.७५.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaśāsa caiva tān sarvān rākṣasān sumahābalān।nādayan gacchatātraiva jayadhvaṁ śīghrameva ca ।। 6.75.47 ।।

translations.english: Seized with anger, he sent for Kumbha and Nikumbha, both the sons of Kumbhakarna and many Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: तद्बन्तर उसी की पैनी तलवार से, प्षननन्द्न ने त्रिशिरा के, कुएडलों से अलडूकृत ओर मुकुटों से भूषित तीनों सिर, बैसे ही काट डाले; जैले इन्द्र ने त्बष्टा छे पुत्र विश्वरूप के सिर काटे थे

verses.sloka: ततस्तु चोदितास्तेन राक्षसा ज्वलितायुधाः।लङ्काया निर्ययुर्वीराः प्रणदन्तः पुनःपुनः ।। ६.७५.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu coditāstena rākṣasā jvalitāyudhāḥ।laṅkāyā niryayurvīrāḥ praṇadantaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.75.48 ।।

translations.english: Yupaksha, Sonithaksha, Prajangha, Kampana set out with both the sons of Kumbhakarna.
translations.hindi: बहुत देर बाद जब कपिश्रेष्ठ ऋषभ को चेत हुआ, तब उसने रपट कर महापाश्व के हाथ से गदा छीन ली

verses.sloka: रक्षसां भूषणस्थाभिर्भाभिः स्वाभिश्च सर्वशः।चक्रुस्ते सप्रभं व्योम हरयश्चाग्निभिः सह ।। ६.७५.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣasāṁ bhūṣaṇasthābhirbhābhiḥ svābhiśca sarvaśaḥ।cakruste saprabhaṁ vyoma harayaścāgnibhiḥ saha ।। 6.75.49 ।।

translations.english: Roaring like a lion, he ordered all the Rakshasas of extraordinary strength to proceed instantly.

verses.sloka: तत्र ताराधिपस्याभा ताराणां च तथैव च।तयोराभरणस्था च बलयोर्द्यामभासयन् ।। ६.७५.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: tatra tārādhipasyābhā tārāṇāṁ ca tathaiva ca।tayorābharaṇasthā ca balayordyāmabhāsayan ।। 6.75.50 ।।

translations.english: Ordered by him again and again, the Rakshasa warriors went from Lanka with glowing weapons offering salutations to him.
translations.hindi: त्रिशिरा, सहोदर और दुधऽं देवान्तक एवं नरान्तक को मरा हुआ देख,

verses.sloka: चन्द्राभा भूषणाभा च गृहाणां ज्वलतां च भा।हरिराक्षससैन्यानि भ्राजयामास सर्वतः ।। ६.७५.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: candrābhā bhūṣaṇābhā ca gṛhāṇāṁ jvalatāṁ ca bhā।harirākṣasasainyāni bhrājayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।। 6.75.51 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas by the effulgence of ornaments and by themselves illumined all over the sky like monkeys did with torches.
translations.hindi: अत्यन्त असहिष्णु राक्षसश्रेष्ठ महापाश्वं अत्यन्त क्रुध हुआ । उसने लोहे की बनो अपनी चमचमाती भयङ्कर और कामोघ गदा उठाई

verses.sloka: तत्र चोर्ध्वं प्रदीप्तानां गृहाणां सागरः पुनः।भाभिः संसक्तपातालश्चलोर्मिः शुशुबे ऽधिकम् ।। ६.७५.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatra cordhvaṁ pradīptānāṁ gṛhāṇāṁ sāgaraḥ punaḥ।bhābhiḥ saṁsaktapātālaścalormiḥ śuśube 'dhikam ।। 6.75.52 ।।

translations.english: There the radiance of the moon and stars and the splendour of their ornaments brightened the sky.
translations.hindi: स रादा में सोने के बन्द लगे हुए थे और बह युद्ध में काल- रूपिणी थी तथा शात्रश्रों के रक्त से रंगी हुई थी

verses.sloka: पताकाध्वजसंसक्तमुत्तमासिपरश्वधम्।भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गं नानापत्तिसमाकुलम् ।। ६.७५.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: patākādhvajasaṁsaktamuttamāsiparaśvadham।bhīmāśvarathamātaṅgaṁ nānāpattisamākulam ।। 6.75.53 ।।

translations.english: The moon light and the splendour of the ornaments, also the light of shining ocean and dwellings lit up the Vanara and Rakshasa armies.

verses.sloka: दीप्तशूलगदाखड्गप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम्।तद्राक्षसबलं घोरं भीमविक्रमपौरुषम् ।। ६.७५.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dīptaśūlagadākhaḍgaprāsatomarakārmukam।tadrākṣasabalaṁ ghoraṁ bhīmavikramapauruṣam ।। 6.75.54 ।।

translations.english: There the waves of the ocean shone brightly getting united with the fire of half burnt houses.

verses.sloka: ददृशो ज्वलितप्रासं किङ्किणीशतनादितम्।हेमजालाचितभुजं व्यामिश्रितपरश्वधम् ।। ६.७५.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: dadṛśo jvalitaprāsaṁ kiṅkiṇīśatanāditam।hemajālācitabhujaṁ vyāmiśritaparaśvadham ।। 6.75.55 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.

verses.sloka: व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रं बाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम्।गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् ।। ६.७५.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vyāghūrṇitamahāśastraṁ bāṇasaṁsaktakārmukam।gandhamālyamadhūtsekasammoditamahānilam ।। 6.75.56 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.
translations.hindi: तब बलबान्‌ ऋषभ नामक वानरयूथपति कूद कर रावण के छोटे भाई महापाश्‍वे के पास जा, उसके सामने खदा हुआ ।]४४॥ त पुरस्तात्‌ स्थितं दृष्टा वानरं पर्वतोपमम्‌ । आजघानोरसि कुद्धो मद्या वजकलपया

verses.sloka: घोरं शूरजनाकीर्णं महाम्बुधरनिस्वनम् ।। ६.७५.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ghoraṁ śūrajanākīrṇaṁ mahāmbudharanisvanam ।। 6.75.57 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.
translations.hindi: उस गदा के लगने से कपिश्रेष्ठ ऋषभ की छाती विदीण हो गई । उसका शरीर काँप उठा और छाती से अहुत सा रक निकल गया

verses.sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा बलमायान्तं राक्षसानां सुदारुणम्।सञ्चचाल प्लवङ्गानां बलमुच्चैर्ननाद च ।। ६.७५.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā balamāyāntaṁ rākṣasānāṁ sudāruṇam।sañcacāla plavaṅgānāṁ balamuccairnanāda ca ।। 6.75.58 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.

verses.sloka: जवेनाप्लुत्य च पुनस्तद्बलं रक्षसां महत्।अभ्ययात् प्रत्यरिबलं पतङ्गा इव पावकम् ।। ६.७५.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: javenāplutya ca punastadbalaṁ rakṣasāṁ mahat।abhyayāt pratyaribalaṁ pataṅgā iva pāvakam ।। 6.75.59 ।।

translations.english: Crowded with fierce warriors coming like thundering rainy clouds, the Rakshasas, and the monkey troops coming forward made loud noises with an elevated tone.

verses.sloka: तेषां भुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि।राक्षसानां बलं श्रेष्ठं भूयस्तरमशोभत ।। ६.७५.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ bhujaparāmarśavyāmṛṣṭaparighāśani।rākṣasānāṁ balaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ bhūyastaramaśobhata ।। 6.75.60 ।।

translations.english: The great army of Rakshasas rushed towards the hostile army just as moths flew up towards flame.
translations.hindi: उस अपनी ही यदा के प्रहार से महापाश्व के दाँत चूर चूर हो गए और आँखें निकल पड़ीं । बजइत पर्वेत की तरह महापाश्वे गिर पड़ा, उसके नेत्र निकल कर बिखर गए, बह गतायु राक्षस निर्जीव हो धरती पर गिर पडा | सहापाश्‍वे के गिरते ही बची हुई राक्षसी सेना भाग गई

verses.sloka: तत्रोन्मत्ता इवोत्पेतुर्हरयो ऽथ युयुत्सवः।तरुशैलैरभिघ्नन्तो मुष्टिभिश्च निशाचरान् ।। ६.७५.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatronmattā ivotpeturharayo 'tha yuyutsavaḥ।taruśailairabhighnanto muṣṭibhiśca niśācarān ।। 6.75.61 ।।

translations.english: Their Clubs and Asanis brandished by rubbing with their arms, the great army of Rakshasas appeared very bright.

verses.sloka: तथैवापततां तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः।शिरांसि सहसा जह्नू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः ।। ६.७५.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathaivāpatatāṁ teṣāṁ kapīnāmasibhiḥ śitaiḥ।śirāṁsi sahasā jahnū rākṣasā bhīmadarśanāḥ ।। 6.75.62 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the monkeys eager to fight with night rangers rose as if gone mad striking the night rangers with trees and rocks.

verses.sloka: दशनैर्हृतकर्णाश्च मुष्टिनिष्कीर्णमस्तकाः।शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गा विचेरुस्तत्र राक्षसाः ।। ६.७५.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśanairhṛtakarṇāśca muṣṭiniṣkīrṇamastakāḥ।śilāprahārabhagnāṅgā vicerustatra rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.75.63 ।।

translations.english: When the Rakshasas showed up in that manner, the monkeys approaching them cut off their heads instantly with sharp swords.
translations.hindi: मि... ता गदा को हाथ में ले वह वीर उसे वानरी सेना को [पं विष्ट या । जिस प्रकार वन में अति प्रचण्ड अभि लपक लपक (SE TE NE HE DE 7-2 सप्ततितस: सगः ७४३ कर वन को भस्म करता है; उसी प्रकार उन्मत्त राक्षस वानरी संना मं लपक लपक कर बानरों का संहार करने लगा

verses.sloka: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामभिलक्षिताः।प्रवीरानभितो जघ्नू राक्षसानां तरस्विनाम् ।। ६.७५.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathaivāpyapare teṣāṁ kapīnāmabhilakṣitāḥ।pravīrānabhito jaghnū rākṣasānāṁ tarasvinām ।। 6.75.64 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas with ears bitten off by the teeth of the monkeys, skulls smashed with fists, and limbs broken with blows of rocks they moved about.

verses.sloka: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः।हरिवीरान्निजघ्नुश्च घोररूपा निशाचराः ।। ६.७५.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathaivāpyapare teṣāṁ kapīnāmasibhiḥ śitaiḥ।harivīrānnijaghnuśca ghorarūpā niśācarāḥ ।। 6.75.65 ।।

translations.english: In the aforesaid manner the Vanaras struck more night rangers of terrific appearance, great heroes in front of them with sharp swords.

verses.sloka: घ्नन्तमन्यं जघानान्यः पातयन्तमपातयत्।गर्हमाणं जगर्हे ऽन्यो दशन्तमपरो ऽदशत् ।। ६.७५.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ghnantamanyaṁ jaghānānyaḥ pātayantamapātayat।garhamāṇaṁ jagarhe 'nyo daśantamaparo 'daśat ।। 6.75.66 ।।

translations.english: One struck another, who was striking the other. One threw down another who was throwing the other. One abused another reproaching contemptuously, and one bit his rival biting the other.
translations.hindi: अपनी गदा के प्रहार से उस विशाल पवत को तोड़ कर उसके सो टुकड़े कर डाले । जज कपिश्रेष्ठ गवा मे देखा कि, उठ राक्षसश्रेष्ठ ने उल पवत के टुकड़ टुकड़े कर डाले हैं

verses.sloka: देहीत्यन्यो ददात्यन्यो ददामीत्यपरः पुनः।किं क्लेशयसि तिष्ठेति तत्रान्योन्यं बभाषिरे ।। ६.७५.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dehītyanyo dadātyanyo dadāmītyaparaḥ punaḥ।kiṁ kleśayasi tiṣṭheti tatrānyonyaṁ babhāṣire ।। 6.75.67 ।।

translations.english: There they conversed this way with one another 'One said hit me and another one offered to hit,', again another intervened and said, 'Why are you crying?' meaning I offer resistance, one said 'Why are you suffering like this?'.
translations.hindi: तब वीर गंवाक्ष को बड़ा आश्चय हुआ ओर वह बार बार गजने लगा । इंससे राक्षपश्रेष्ठ उन्मत्त अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हुआ स उसने चमचमाती

verses.sloka: विप्रलम्बितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचायुधम्।समुद्यतमहाप्रासं यष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम्।प्रावर्तत महारौद्रं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् ।। ६.७५.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vipralambitavastraṁ ca vimuktakavacāyudham।samudyatamahāprāsaṁ yaṣṭiśūlāsisaṅkulam।prāvartata mahāraudraṁ yuddhaṁ vānararakṣasām ।। 6.75.68 ।।

translations.english: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.

verses.sloka: वानरान् दश सप्तेति राक्षसा जघ्नुराहवे।राक्षसान् दश सप्तेति वानराश्चाभ्यपातयन् ।। ६.७५.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarān daśa sapteti rākṣasā jaghnurāhave।rākṣasān daśa sapteti vānarāścābhyapātayan ।। 6.75.69 ।।

translations.english: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.

verses.sloka: विस्रस्तकेशवसनं विध्वस्तकवचध्वजम्।बलं राक्षसमालम्ब्य वानराः पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.७५.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: visrastakeśavasanaṁ vidhvastakavacadhvajam।balaṁ rākṣasamālambya vānarāḥ paryavārayan ।। 6.75.70 ।।

translations.english: In that fight the Rakshasas killed the Vanaras at the rate of ten to seven and the Vanaras struck down Rakshasas at the rate of ten to seven.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe pañcasaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 75 ।।

translations.hindi: दाँत टूट गए और आँखें निकल पड़ीं । उसके शरीर से गर्म लोहू बहने लगा ओर बह्‌ निर्जीव हो पृथिबीं पर गिर पडा
